stem: 5 buyers each want one unit with values [28, 34, 40, 46, 52]; 5 sellers each can supply one with resource costs [45, 37, 53, 41, 49]. Values and costs are in dollars. Exactly 2 units are produced by the cheapest sellers, but the lowest-valued buyer receives one instead of the buyer whose willingness to pay is $46. What would reallocating that one unit, with no transaction cost, do?
